A separate local scheduler candidate is 21 commits ahead but overlaps five modified files and was not merged. The 38-chat registry remains a valid 2026-08-09 point-in-time snapshot; the app's recent window currently exposes six Complex Perfumery chats and two conversation IDs newer than that snapshot, but it does not prove a complete current enumeration. Fifteen focused receipt test files passed 33 tests locally. This packet updates context and holds only.
